senses.gloss:
कथ् कथ् (this rt. is perhaps connected
with कथम्), cl. 10. P., ep. also A.
कथयति, -ते, aor. अचकथत् or अचीकथत्, -यि-
तुम्, to converse with any one (with inst. c. alone or
after सह); to tell, relate, narrate, report, inform,
speak about, declare, explain (with acc. of the thing
or person spoken about); to describe; to denounce,
betray; to suppose, state; Pass. कथ्यते, to be
[]
called; be regarded or considered as: Desid. चिक-
थयिषति, to desire to tell; [cf. Goth. qvath;
Eng. quoth and quote; Gr. κωτίλος, κωτίλλω.]

कथक, अस्, आ, अम्, a narrator, a relater, one
who recites a story or who publicly reads and ex-
pounds the Purāṇas &c., one who speaks or tells;
(अस्, आ), m. f. the speaker of a prologue or mono-
logue; a professional story-teller; chief actor; (अस्),
m., N. of a man.

काथक काथक and काथक्य, patronymics
from Kathaka.

कथन, अस्, आ, अम्, telling, talkative; (अम्), n.
the act of telling, narration, relating, informing.

कथनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be said, to be told or
declared; worthy of relation, to be named.
कथयान, अस्, आ, अम्, telling, speaking.

कथयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be told, to be men-
tioned, to be communicated.

1. कथा, f. conversation, speech, tale; a fable, a
feigned story; talk, mention; (in phil.) disputation;
का कथा (with gen. or more commonly with loc.
and sometimes with प्रति), what should one
say of? how should one speak of? (e. g. एको ऽपि
कृच्छ्राद् वर्तेत, भूयसां कथैव का, even
one person would live with difficulty, what should
one say of many? i. e. how much more many?).
—कथाक्रम (˚था-आक्˚), अस्, m. the commence-
ment of a conversation.
—कथा-छल, अम्, n. the
device of a fable.
—कथा-जव, अस्, m., N. of a
man.
—कथानुराग (˚था-अन्˚), अस्, m. attention,
taking pleasure in a discourse.
—कथान्त (˚था-
अन्˚), अस्, m. end of a conversation.
—कथान्तर
(˚था-अन्˚), अम्, n. the course of a conversation.
—कथा-पीठ, N. of the first Lambaka or book of
the Kathā-sarit-sāgara.
—कथा-प्रबन्ध, अस्, m.
a narrative, a tale, a composed story, a fiction.
—क-
था-प्रसङ्ग, अस्, m. connection of speeches or
discourse, talking, conversation, speaking to or with,
rumour, report; (अस्, आ, अम्), talkative, talking much
and foolishly, half-witted, foolish; a conjuror, a dealer
in antidotes &c.
—कथा-प्राण, अस्, m. an actor,
the speaker of a prologue or monologue, the intro-
ducer of a drama; a professed story-teller.
—कथा-
मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of tales.
—कथा-मुख,
अम्, n. the introduction to a tale; N. of the second
Lambaka or book of the Kathā-sarit-sāgara.
—कथा-
योग, अस्, m. conversation, talk, discourse.
—कथा-
रम्भ (˚था-आर्˚), अस्, m. beginning of a story or
narrative, story-telling.
—कथारम्भ-काल (˚था-
आर्˚), अस्, m. story-beginning-time.
—कथाराम
(˚था-आर्˚), अस्, m. garden of fable.
—कथार्णव
(˚था-अर्˚), अस्, m., N. of a collection of stories at-
tributed to Śivadāsa.
—कथालाप (˚था-आल्˚), अस्,
m. speech, conversation.
—कथावशेष (˚था-अव्˚),
or कथा-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्, one of whom only the
narrative remains, i. e. deceased, dead; कथाव-
शेषतां गतः, deceased, dead.
—कथा-विरक्त,
अस्, आ, अम्, reserved, taciturn, disliking conversation.
—कथा-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. a collection of tales or
fables.
—कथा-सरित्-सागर, अस्, m. the ocean of
the rivers of stories; title of a work of Somadeva.
—कथोदय (˚था-उद्˚), अस्, m. the beginning of
a tale, introduction to a tale.
—कथोद्घात (˚था-
उद्˚), अस्, m. the opening of a drama by the character
that first enters overhearing and repeating the last
words of the prelude.
—कथोपकथन (˚था-उप्˚),
अम्, n. conversation, conference, narration.
—कथो-
पाख्यान (˚था-उप्˚), अम्, n. narration, narrative,
relation, telling a story.

2. कथा, ind. (for कथम्), Ved. how? whence?
why? Sometimes merely a particle of interrogation
(e. g. कथा शृणोति इन्द्रः, does Indra hear?
यथा कथा च, in any way whatsoever).

कथानक, अम्, n. a small tale; [cf. क्रयाणक,
भयानक, &c.]

कथापय, nom. P. कथापयति, -यितुम्, to
tell, relate, &c.

कथिक, अस्, ई, अम्, a narrator, a relater, a story-
teller by profession.

कथित, अस्, आ, अम्, told, said, related; (अम्), n.
a conversation, discourse.
—कथित-पद, अम्, n.
repetition, tautology.

कथी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्,
to transform into a tale.
—कथी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्,
transformed into a tale, deceased, dead (e. g. कथी-
कृतं वपुः, a body of which one can only give
a history, a deceased body).

कथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken about, to be
told, fit to be mentioned.

कथ्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being told or mentioned,
under narration.

कथम् कथम् (fr. 2. क), ind. how? in what
manner? whence? (e. g. कथम् एतत्, how is that?
कथम् इदानीम्, how now? what is now to be
done? कथम् मारात्मके त्वयि विश्वासः, how
can there be reliance on thee of murderous mind?
कथम् उत्सृज्य त्वां गच्छेयम्, how can I go
away deserting you? कथम् बुद्ध्वा भविष्यति
सा, how will she be when she awakes? कथम् मृ-
त्युः प्रभवति वेदविदाम्, whence is it that death
has power over those that know the Veda? कथम्
अवगम्यते, whence is it inferred?). Sometimes
कथम् merely introduces an interrogation (e. g. क-
थम् आत्मानं निवेदयामि कथं वा आत्मा-
पहारं करोमि, shall I declare myself or shall I
withdraw ?).

कथम् is often found in connection with the
particles इव, नाम, नु, स्विद्, which appear to gene-
ralize the interrogation (how possibly? &c.); with नु
it sometimes = किमु or कुतस् (e. g. कथं नु, how
much more! न कथं नु, how much less!).

कथम् is often connected, like किम्, with the
particles चन, चिद्, and अपि, which give an inde-
finite sense to the interrogative (e. g. कथं चन,
in no way, not at all). When not itself negative
कथं चन = in some way, some how; scarcely,
with difficulty; न कथं चन, in no way; क-
थञ्चित्, some how or other, by some means or
other, in any way, with some difficulty, scarcely, in
a moderate degree, a little; न कथञ्चित्, not at all,
in no way whatever; न कथञ्चिद् न, in no way
not, i. e. most decidedly; यथा कथञ्चित्, in any
way whatsoever; कथञ्चिद् यदि जीवति, it is with
difficulty that he lives; कथम् अपि, some how or
other, with some difficulty, scarcely, a little; कथम्
अपि न, by no means, not at all. In addition to
the above senses lexicographers assert that कथम्
may imply ‘amazement, surprise, pleasure, abuse;’
[with कथम् cf. Gr. κατά.]
At the beginning of an adjective compound कथम्
may have the same sense as किम्.
—कथं-रूप,
अस्, आ, अम्, of what shape ?
—कथं-वीर्य, अस्,
आ, अम्, of what power?
—कथङ्-कथिक, अस्,
आ, अम् (fr. कथम् कथम्), one who is always
asking questions, an inquisitive person.
—कथङ्-
कथिक-ता, f. questioning, inquiring, inquisitiveness.
—कथङ्कथित (?), अस्, m. an interrogant, one
who puts questions.
—कथन्-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, how
acting.
—कथङ्-कारम्, ind. in which manner?
—कथन्-ता, f. enquiry, question, demand.
—क-
थम्-प्रमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, of what measure?
—क-
थम्-भाव, अस्, m. what state?
—कथम्-भूत,
अस्, आ, अम्, how being? of what kind?

काथञ्चित्क काथञ्चित्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. कथञ्-
चिद्), accomplished with difficulty.
